image_description: A close-up, rear-view shot of a baby wearing a light teal/mint green cloth diaper. The diaper appears to be made of a soft, fabric-like material (likely cotton or bamboo) rather than the smooth plastic of disposable diapers. It features elasticized leg openings with gathered ruffles and a visible waistband. A small portion of an adhesive tab or fastener is visible on the right hip area. The baby's legs and lower torso are visible against a plain white background.
